scope: New developmental estimand after timing-floor observations; conditional evidence retention plus full-GT gains/losses, not a safety or efficiency verdict
input: Fixed original 256 SpikeFPN and signed180ms input; no training or representation changes
ranking_precision: C-contiguous float32 descriptors before channel reductions, matching historical cache-copy protocol; float64 storage preserves these computed scores exactly
primary: Same dense-calibrated threshold for every policy; not matched false positives. Conditional drop on a shared dense-matched GT/frame population, with gains, full-GT and FPPI mandatory
supplementary: Per-condition thun threshold frozen before evaluation; achieved evaluation FPPI disclosed

exchange.sampling: Uniformly sample query indices without replacement, including no-GT queries; sample distinct selected/omitted same-scale pairs within each named pool. Plan serialized before outcome evaluation. No GT or detector-head confidence used for pair choice
exchange.utility: Report deltaTP and deltaFP separately, all zero/positive/negative outcomes. No fitted scalar weight or global oracle claim

limitations: All sequences development-exposed; no formal H1/H2/H3 verdict or generalization CI
Conditional dense population is not all driving targets
Offline anchor admission before NMS, not actual skipped computation
No importance/hybrid correction implemented in this audit
Prior absolute timing failures and selected-kernel numeric failure retained
